title: Component
says: A holon that declares the types it takes and draws what it is given, opening space in it where what it holds is drawn in turn by the components that match. It is made of code, or of data: mounts held as its template.

says.says: What it draws, in a sentence.

takes.says: The types whose instances it draws; none means it draws any holon, when nothing closer matches.

kinds.says: The kinds of slot it draws in, as full or face.

argument.says: What a mount of it is given: one holon, a list of holons, a selection, either, or a way of looking, with the list it gathers; one holon unless it says otherwise.

settings.says: The settings it takes from the slot that opens it, each said in prose with its shape, as a type declares its fields; none unless it says.

reads.says: The reads it makes of the field beyond what it is handed, by their forms, as holders or instances: what it may look at, said where it can be seen. None unless it says.

code.says: The module the interface runs, as JavaScript, for a component made of code.

template.says: For a component made of data instead of code: the mounts it is drawn as, in order, each giving `$`, what the component itself is given, and, where it says so, the kind of slot it is and the component it calls.

kind.says: The kind of slot the mount is, where it says so.

argument.says: What the mount gives: `$`, what the component itself was given.

component.says: The component the mount calls, where it names one; otherwise one is found for what it is given.

source.says: The code as it was written, before it was built.

from.says: Where the holon was born from, as a path in the files it arrived from.
